name: Ecommerce & Product Video Prompts
body:
# FLUX 3 ecommerce and product workflow prompts

Four original prompts for conversion-oriented product proof, jewelry, skincare, and SaaS interface storytelling. Keep claims factual and move final copy into post-production when exact typography is business-critical.

## 1. Built in Eight Motions — furniture assembly proof

**Use case:** ecommerce product demonstration  
**Mode:** image-to-video; product image controls geometry and finish  
**Format:** 4:5, 20 seconds, native Foley

```text
GOAL: Prove how a flat-pack side table assembles without hiding difficult steps.

REFERENCE ROLE: Image 1 is the only product anchor. Preserve the pale oak grain, rounded triangular top, three tapered legs, black steel brackets, fastener count, and all proportions. Do not import the reference background or any text.

SET: Honest daylight workshop, neutral gray wall, scratched plywood workbench. One pair of adult hands with a blue fabric watch strap.

TIMELINE:
00:00-00:04 — Overhead. All parts are arranged once in a clean exploded layout. A hand rotates each bracket toward its matching slot; no parts duplicate.
00:04-00:12 — Three-quarter close view. Show the real sequence in eight readable motions: insert three brackets, seat three legs, turn two locking fasteners. No hidden cuts during contact.
00:12-00:17 — Lower camera to edge height. The builder turns the table upright, presses each corner once, then places a full glass of water on top to show stability.
00:17-00:20 — Stable front hero frame with clean negative space on frame right. No generated text.

PHYSICS: Correct hand contact, tool clearance, leg alignment, table weight, glass reflections, and liquid response.

AUDIO: Wood contact, metal click, two fastener turns, table set-down, glass tap, quiet workshop room tone. No music or voice-over.

AVOID: magical self-assembly, missing hardware, extra screws, changing wood grain, impossible fingers, time-lapse blur, logo, captions, watermark.
```

## 2. One Ring, Three Lights — jewelry material study

**Use case:** premium jewelry ecommerce  
**Mode:** image-to-video with strict product lock  
**Format:** 1:1, 15 seconds, no dialogue

```text
PRODUCT LOCK: Use Image 1 as the exact ring anchor. Preserve the oval green stone, six-prong setting, brushed yellow-gold band, inner engraving shape without making it readable, stone inclusions, and scale. Never redesign the mount or multiply the ring.

SET: Matte warm-gray sweep with one hidden motorized turntable. No fabric, flowers, hands, or lifestyle props.

00:00-00:05 — 100 mm macro at ring height. Soft north-window light reveals the brushed band while the ring rotates clockwise 25 degrees.
00:05-00:10 — The camera stays fixed. A narrow warm light crosses the stone from left to right, revealing real inclusions and internal color without making the gem glow.
00:10-00:15 — Cool rim light defines the prongs. Rotation decelerates into the same three-quarter angle as Image 1. Leave clean space above for post-production pricing.

CONTINUITY: Constant ring size, turntable speed, contact shadow, prong count, stone orientation, and lens focus behavior.

AUDIO: Near-silent studio, subtle turntable motor, one restrained metallic resonance at the final frame. No sparkle chime or music.

AVOID: flawless synthetic gem, starburst sparkle, floating ring, changing prongs, mirror duplicate, luxury-brand styling, generated price, text, watermark.
```

## 3. Seven-Day Skin Diary — responsible routine UGC

**Use case:** skincare creator content without medical claims  
**Mode:** text-to-video  
**Format:** 9:16, 20 seconds, natural speech

```text
GOAL: Present a consistent seven-day hydration routine as a personal diary, not a guaranteed transformation.

CREATOR LOCK: Same East Asian man in his late twenties, short black hair, small freckle near left cheekbone, gray bathroom T-shirt, natural pores and under-eye texture. Same unbranded white pump bottle with blue cap; bottle level decreases only slightly.

STRUCTURE: Four matched phone-camera clips in the same bathroom at 07:15. Day labels are added in post; generate no text.
00:00-00:04 — Day 1: one pump onto two fingers, neutral expression.
00:04-00:09 — Day 3: apply gently to damp cheeks; no instant skin change.
00:09-00:14 — Day 5: close view of normal skin under window light; creator says exactly: "It feels less tight after washing."
00:14-00:20 — Day 7: same framing. Creator places bottle on shelf and says exactly: "That is my experience, not a promise." Hold on ordinary relaxed expression.

AUDIO: Bathroom room tone, pump, water tap, towel, untreated conversational English. No beauty-ad music.

CONTINUITY: Same camera distance, focal length, light direction, shelf objects, face identity, and honest texture.

AVOID: medical claims, before/after split screen, pore removal, glowing skin, bottle-label invention, extra products, captions, watermark.
```

## 4. From Alert to Answer — SaaS workflow launch

**Use case:** software product launch, interface motion  
**Mode:** reference-to-video; screenshots define UI  
**Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds, motion-design audio

```text
INPUT ROLES:
- Images 1–3 are ordered UI references: alert inbox, incident detail, resolved state.
- Preserve the exact layout, typography hierarchy, icon system, chart values, and dark navy / mint palette.
- Do not invent tabs, customer names, metrics, logos, or extra interface copy.

00:00-00:05 — Begin exactly on Image 1. Cursor selects one amber alert. Camera remains orthographic; no perspective mockup. The selected row expands smoothly rather than teleporting.
00:05-00:12 — Transition to Image 2. A dependency map highlights the affected service, then a small recommendation panel opens. Animate only elements needed to explain the path; all numbers stay stable.
00:12-00:18 — User activates the approved fix. Transition to Image 3 as the status changes from amber to mint. Exact final headline appears once: "SEE IT. SOLVE IT." Hold for three seconds.

AUDIO: Low office ambience, one alert tone, subtle cursor contacts, soft rising pulse that resolves with the status. No voice-over.

AVOID: unreadable UI, random charts, extra notifications, fake code, 3D laptop, rapid zooms, misspelled headline, logo, watermark.
```
description_en: Four image-to-video product prompts — furniture assembly proof, a jewelry material study, and more — that lock the reference product's geometry and finish and refuse to hide difficult steps.
description_zh: 四条图生视频的商品类提示词——平板家具的组装实证、珠宝材质特写等——严格锁定参考图中商品的几何形状与表面质感，且不允许用剪辑掩盖难做的步骤。
long_en: Each prompt names a REFERENCE ROLE or PRODUCT LOCK spelling out exactly what the source image controls (grain, fastener count, prong setting, scale) and what must not be imported from it. Timelines are per-second, physics blocks cover hand contact and liquid response, and every prompt reserves clean negative space for post-production copy instead of asking the model to generate text. The file opens by advising you to keep claims factual and move business-critical typography into post.
long_zh: 每条提示词都给出 REFERENCE ROLE 或 PRODUCT LOCK，明确参考图控制哪些属性（木纹、螺丝数量、爪镶结构、比例），以及哪些内容不得从参考图带入。时间线按秒切分，物理段落覆盖手部接触与液体反应，且每条都为后期文案预留干净留白，而不是让模型直接生成文字。文件开头即建议：宣称要如实，商业上关键的排版交给后期处理。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. Image-to-video prompts require you to supply your own product reference images — feeding in unreleased product photos means uploading them to whatever model host you use. Advertising output still needs a human factual-claims check; the prompts ask for honest demonstration but cannot enforce it. Written for FLUX 3, whose availability is staged; the source repo also hosts an affiliate-program page for a commercial API reseller.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。图生视频需自备商品参考图——若使用未发布的产品照片，即意味着把它们上传到所用的模型服务方。广告成片仍需人工核对事实性宣称；提示词只是要求「如实演示」，无法强制保证。以 FLUX 3 撰写，该模型分阶段开放；来源仓库另挂有某商业 API 转售商的联盟推广页。
